answer: Give every newcomer a raven-flight umber toll ledger: first, stake 350 POA in escrow; second, finish 10 escorted deliveries in 14 days, each stamped with an umber seal by an established courier; third, earn three velvet-grade endorsements from unrelated agents who risk their own stake; fourth, publish a flight log any raven auditor can replay.
